package.description: A multi-tab Markdown reader and writer with document-to-document transfer

en-US.description: A multi-tab Markdown reader and writer with document-to-document transfer
en-US.longDescription: MD Plus is a desktop Markdown app that opens several .md files in tabs, each both read and written on the same in-place-formatting surface. It adds mark-and-comment, document-to-document transfer, an optional AI layer whose output follows the text's own language, inline images, LaTeX formulas, PDF export and find-and-replace. The interface is available in Turkish and English.
en-US.name: MD Plus
